parsed.answer: This has been reported before: PowerToys silently disables (or re-enables) modules after a restart, update or sleep. The most recent report, #46880, was closed as a duplicate of #43449, which is the issue to follow. It was still unfixed as of April 2026, and the maintainers planned to look at it after 0.99. #35414 was likewise closed as a duplicate of #24339. Earlier reports (#23111, #16125) were resolved by updating or reinstalling PowerToys. So: 1) update to the latest PowerToys release; if that doesn't help, uninstall and reinstall it cleanly. 2) Follow #43449 for a real fix, and add your bug report ZIP and version (v0.101.2362, Microsoft Store) there. 3) Until it is fixed, re-disable the modules you don't want after a restart, update, or long sleep. Note that your ticket describes modules turning back ON rather than OFF, which is the reverse of #46880 and #35414, though the cause appears to be the same settings not persisting.
